item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 3d61f106; 124cbf09 is the repair (+9/-2, +8/-1 and +6/-0 across the three test files: two elapsed bounds and one mtime-fallback bound replaced by _PROMOTION_HANG_GUARD_SECONDS = 60.0, plus monkeypatch.setenv("RECKON_MCP_READ_DEADLINE_SECONDS", "240") in test_ledger's home fixture) and b965d94a is the record (the archived evidence section +74/-0, the figure script +114 and its .png, the plan +38/-0); every docs line is additive against base, the archived page's anchors go 10 to 11 and the plan gains one landed node, so no peer node's landed record was displaced and no plan-version or plan-modified meta line was touched; no fold-source, fallback or payload assertion was removed, only the wall-clock tightness of three of them.
item_verdicts.done_when: every leg is present and independently checked: the base failures are visible in base-tree loaded runs (load6-1.log shows restored assertions in the 7.5-16.5 s range against the 2.0 s and 5.0 s bounds plus the ledger read reported as an unknown storage-slow result against the production 30 s default so it fails with KeyError: 'view'; n8-5ids.log is a second base-tree arm at assert 7.7601 < 2.0), head-ids.log is 7 passed at head, the diff names no reckon/ file and no skipped, xfailed or deleted test, and the declared negative-control string is repeated verbatim as the first line of negative-control-red.log whose body is the load6-1 base run; the recorded ids carry their attempted instruments (28 loaded attempts for the terminal-record fold id, never reproduced for the two test_crew ids) and the manifest says plainly that "never reproduced" is the evidence.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the four load-sensitive wall-clock and observation tests hold under -n 8 load, and the landed change makes each named id either hold or be recorded as measured-and-held: the two receipt bounds and the promotion mtime-fallback bound become a finite 60 s hang guard, with the fixture-pinned 0.5 s settle ceiling still doing the property work, and the ledger test's home fixture raises RECKON_MCP_READ_DEADLINE_SECONDS to 240 so a loaded whole-project read is not misreported as a typed storage-slow unknown; the loaded verification at head carries the measure (verify-round-1 107 passed in 247.40 s and verify-round-3 107 passed in 242.32 s, each under -n 8 with four concurrent -n 8 load copies), and verification round 2's two failures are external (see evidence).
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; status complete (rewritten by the coordinator from in-progress with the as-delivered manifest preserved beside it), commits 124cbf09 b965d94a, base 3d61f106, head b965d94a, the eight named log paths, the declared negative-control string and the evidenced duration figures all match the diff and the logs they name, which I opened; two wording nits, neither a defect: the negative_control_note's parenthetical groups the base values loosely against the two bounds (7.76 was measured against < 2.0 in n8-5ids.log, and its sibling values are rounded renderings of the load6 series), and the 36.3 s ledger figure is carried in the stream record rather than retained as a log file.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff --numstat 3d61f106 b965d94a returns exactly the seven declared paths and nothing else, the three test files plus the figure script and its .png inside docs/figures/the-suite-is-green-at-head, the archived evidence page and the plan, with nothing under reckon/; the declared tests/test_crew.py is unevidenced by the diff, which is within scope because declared paths are an allowance rather than a required list.

justifications.durability: the relaxed assertions still redden on the mechanism they name, which I measured in scratch trees of b965d94a: removing the settle ceiling reddens the receipt test at reckon/crew/promotion.py:2194 through pytest-timeout (1 failed in 60.60 s, log negative-control-ceiling-removed.log), and the ledger fixture's setenv leaves the deadline guard's own coverage in tests/test_mcp_reads_have_deadlines.py intact; three points withheld because the 60 s guard no longer distinguishes a prompt release from a stall well under a minute (my fixed 45 s-ceiling arm passed in 45.94 s where the old 2.0 s bound would have failed, log negative-control-ceiling-fortyfive.log), and because "never reproduced" for the two test_crew ids is an absence of evidence rather than evidence of absence.
justifications.evidence: the loaded rounds, the base and head arms and the probe figures were checked against the logs named, and I independently falsified the durability claim in scratch trees built with git archive b965d94a (control 1 passed in 3.12 s; the ledger fixture's raised deadline verified to have its own coverage in tests/test_mcp_reads_have_deadlines.py); two points withheld because the declared negative control is assembled rather than freshly executed (the declared string line prepended to a base-tree run, disclosed as such) and because the 36.3 s ledger figure lives in the stream record rather than in a retained log.
justifications.fit: the repair follows the idiom already in these files, a named module constant with the measurement behind it in the comment beside it and monkeypatch.setenv inside the existing home fixture, and the three naming checks over the diff's added lines return no plan, sprint, ticket, version or changelog-prose identifier; one withheld for the same constant and comment being duplicated across the two receipt-side test files where one could have been imported, a tidiness point rather than a defect.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the four relaxations are exactly the class the goal names, the settle-ceiling property is still exercised through the fixture-pinned 0.5 s ceiling, and the three recorded ids are recorded rather than silently dropped; one point withheld because the round-2 exclusions rest on attribution rather than on a rerun with the peer's writer isolated, so "holds under load" is evidenced for two of three rounds.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is exactly the declared paths, every docs change is additive, nothing under reckon/ was edited, no test was skipped, xfailed, deleted or had a bound removed outright, and the same four assertions pass at head in the loaded rounds.
